claim_traces.claim_title: Generative AI will replace 300 million jobs
claim_traces.claim_text: "Generative AI will replace 300 million jobs worldwide."
reasoning_steps: The claim oversimplifies and distorts the findings of a widely cited March 2023 Goldman Sachs economics report
The study estimated that generative AI could expose roughly 300 million full-time jobs worldwide to automation or replace the equivalent workload of tasks

However, the report explicitly emphasized that exposure does not equate to outright job elimination; for most workers and industries, generative AI is expected to complement human labor rather than fully replace it, alongside creating new roles and boosting global productivity
Presenting this figure as a definitive prediction that 300 million jobs "will be replaced" strips essential nuance from the projection.

search_results.title: Congress hasn’t passed a budget on time since 1997. We should fix that.
search_results.snippet: December 18, 2025 - The Constitution grants Congress the “power of the purse” through Article I, Section 9, which states that “No Money shall be drawn from the Treasury, but in Consequence of Appropriations made by Law.” Critically, the Constitution doesn’t mandate the current authorization and annual appropriations process currently used. It simply requires that spending be authorized by law. The “textbook” legislative process requires Congress to pass approximately 12 appropriations bills by Oct. 1 for the following fiscal year — something Congress hasn’t done since 1996. Instead, the country lurches from continuing resolution to continuing resolution, with shutdowns or their threat becoming routine weapons in partisan warfare. Federal agencies can’t plan, contractors face uncertainty, and essential services hang in the balance while politicians posture.
